Job Summary

Are you a results-oriented contract and supply management professional who enjoys navigating complex stakeholder environments and ensuring strategic manufacturing partnerships operate effectively?

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients, and Health & Biosciences, delivering sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

Our Health & Biosciences team channels a passion for nature and bioscience into sustainable, life-enhancing technologies that power innovative solutions across healthcare, food, consumer, and industrial markets.

The position is to oversee and manage the related Product Supply Agreements and Product Manufacture Agreements with associated IFF legal entities. This individual will be a key business partner in this pivotal role between the two parties. The successful candidate will ensure compliance, maintain strong working relationships, and manage the contractual obligations of both parties to ensure the successful execution of these contractual arrangements.

This role can be based either in Brugge, Belgium/ Leiden, Netherlands/ Niebüll, Germany/ Dangé-Saint-Romain, France/ Lyngby, Denmark OR Hanko, Naantali, Finland in a hybrid working arrangement.

Where You’ll Make a Difference

• Act as the primary point of contact for all matters related to the supply agreements and the operating service contracts.
• Administer and monitor contractual obligations, ensuring compliance with established terms, service levels, supply requirements, and operational requirements.
• Maintain a repository of contract documents, correspondence, and amendments to ensure easy access and accuracy.
• Ensure compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements, while identifying and mitigating potential risks in partnership with Legal, Procurement, and relevant stakeholders.
• Build strong cross-functional relationships across organizations, facilitating communication, resolving issues, and ensuring questions are routed to the appropriate stakeholders.
• Monitor and analyze contract performance metrics, including quality, delivery, volume, service levels, and financial performance, and provide regular reporting with actionable insights.
• Facilitate contract amendments, revisions, and renegotiations as business needs evolve, ensuring all updates are properly documented and communicated.
• Provide guidance and training to internal stakeholders on contract requirements, compliance expectations, and best practices to facilitate effective contract execution and governance.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business, manufacturing, supply chain, a technical discipline, or a related field.
• Proven experience in procurement, contract manufacturing, supply chain, manufacturing operations, contract administration, or a comparable role.
• Strong working knowledge of contract administration, negotiation principles, compliance requirements, and risk management practices.
• Ability to interpret complex contractual language and explain requirements clearly and concisely to stakeholders across functions and organizational levels.
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, detailed records, notice periods, deliverables, and related requirements with a high level of accuracy.

How Would You Stand Out?

• Experience managing supply agreements or third-party manufacturing relationships in a divestiture, transition, or corporate restructuring environment.
• Familiarity with legacy International Flavors & Fragrances (IFF) Food Ingredients and H&B businesses, products, sites, and manufacturing assets.
• Experience working in manufacturing and using contract management software or related digital tools.

Why Choose Us?

• Play a pivotal role in the successful operation of strategically important supply and manufacturing agreements.
• Gain broad exposure across H&B leadership, manufacturing sites, business teams, and external partners in Europe.
• Influence product supply, service delivery, risk management, and financial planning across a complex business environment.
• Work on high-impact, cross-functional topics that combine commercial, operational, legal, and supply chain considerations.
• Build effective relationships with senior stakeholders and key partners across multiple functions and organizations.

ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on lead to build and run OpenAI's Incidents & Escalations function within User Operations. This is a player-coach role with a meaningful hands-on operating component. You will set the operating model and also step into active incidents and urgent escalations when needed, coordinating with on-call teams, driving clear ownership, supporting communications, and ensuring issues move through resolution and post-incident closure.

During active incidents, you will coordinate with the relevant on-call teams and cross-functional responders across Engineering, Infrastructure, Support Delivery, Product, and Go-To-Market. You will help keep teams aligned, maintain timelines, clarify ownership, escalate when needed, and ensure internal, executive, customer-facing, and external communications are accurate and timely, including status page updates when required.

For escalations, you will build and run the processes for tracking, triaging, mitigating, and resolving critical customer and user issues. After incidents and escalations, you will own the follow-through: retrospectives, root cause identification, action item tracking, trend analysis, and process improvements that reduce repeat issues over time. You will also help define the long-term operating model for incidents and escalations across Support Delivery, Engineering, Infrastructure, and other cross-functional partners.

This role is ideal for someone who can operate calmly under pressure, bring structure to ambiguity, communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences, and improve the system while overseeing day to day operations.

This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

- Participate in an on-call rotation and serve as the active incident lead during live incidents and urgent escalations.

- Own alert intake and triage process across support, safety, customer, and service-impacting issues.

- Assess severity, determine scope and impact, and initiate the appropriate response path.

- Page and coordinate Engineering, Infrastructure, Support Delivery, Product, Legal, Policy, Go-To-Market, and other teams as needed.

- Lead incident response calls, manage timelines, clarify roles, and keep responders focused and unblocked.

- Set internal guidelines for incident communications to all users, including enterprise customers, and own internal updates, executive briefings, customer-facing updates, and external status page updates where required.

- Maintain situational awareness across all customer-facing incidents and parallel workstreams, ensuring the response remains coordinated and customer impact is understood.

- Create and operate the process for monitoring, processing, mitigating, and resolving critical escalations, including formal closure and handoff.

- Identify root causes behind incidents and escalations, lead retrospectives, and coordinate corrective action with accountable teams.

- Track corrective actions to closure and ensure follow-through is focused on the best possible customer outcome.

- Identify recurring operational issues, escalation patterns, and product or process gaps.

- Partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, Product and Support leaders to stay ahead of customer-facing incidents, reduce repeat issues, and improve readiness.

- Improve incident response processes, severity frameworks, playbooks, tooling, reporting, and automation.

- Build a durable operating model for incidents and escalations as OpenAI scales globally.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

- Have 8+ years of experience in incident management, technical support, escalation management, SRE, technical program management, or production operations.

- Have 5+ years of hands-on experience working in production, on-call, or high-urgency operational environments.

- Have 4+ years of leadership experience, ideally in a Support, Engineering, or similar environment.

- Are comfortable acting as Incident Commander, owning coordination, decision-making, communication, and accountability during live incidents.

- Have direct experience with customer-impacting incidents, executive escalations, safety-sensitive escalations, or high-severity technical issues.

- Can communicate clearly under pressure with engineers, support teams, executives, customer-facing teams, and external stakeholders.

- Have hands-on experience with incident communications, including internal updates, executive briefings, customer updates, and status pages.

- Are experienced with incident management, paging, and alerting tools such as incident.io http://incident.io, PagerDuty, Datadog, Jira, Salesforce, Zendesk, or similar systems.

- Understand monitoring and observability well enough to reason about alerts, system health, customer impact, and incident scope.

- Can lead post-incident retrospectives that produce clear root causes, corrective actions, and durable improvements.

- Drive action items to closure and hold teams accountable without creating unnecessary process drag.

- Are highly organized, calm, and structured in ambiguous or high-pressure situations.

- Can balance hands-on incident execution with longer-term systems building.

- Are excited to use AI and automation to improve triage, routing, summarization, reporting, knowledge management, and incident follow-through.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. jobs.description: Job Description The Team: The BSW (Basic Software) Memory Boot & Programming Services team is a core embedded-software group responsible for the memory, boot, and programming capabilities that enable GM electronic control units (ECUs) to securely receive, store, validate, and update software and calibration content across manufacturing, service, engineering, and over-the-air use cases. The team develops and integrates boot managers, bootloaders, bootloader updaters, memory and data-management services, programming flows, and related security components, while partnering closely with hardware, application software, vehicle programs, suppliers, manufacturing, and service organizations to deliver reliable, production-ready embedded infrastructure. The team is part of GM’s Mechatronic Software Platform organization, within Embedded Platform Systems & Infrastructure, whose mission is to provide robust mechatronic software infrastructure that enables customer-facing vehicle features and functions. The Role: We are now hiring for a Staff Software Engineer for Boot Software within the BSW Memory Boot & Programing Services team! This role is referred to as NATS (New Architecture Technical Specialist) within GM, and serves as the primary expert for ECU Boot software (Boot SW). You will define and evolve Boot SW for new SDV controller families, lead deep‑dive troubleshooting of Boot issues, and execute advanced integration work to bring up and stabilize new architectures. This role requires someone who can confidently juggle multiple programs and priorities, stay calm under pressure, and consistently drive issues to clear, data‑driven closure. You will lead the bring-up of new controller architectures, develop and evaluate new Boot designs, and drive a balanced, scalable architecture that enables high‑quality software delivery across multiple programs. This is a senior individual contributor role (GM Level 8) that operates at the intersection of hardware, basic software, application, solution, and systems teams, and aggressively leverages AI tools across design, integration, debugging, documentation, and standard work to increase both speed and quality. What You’ll Do (Responsibilities): Drive evaluation of Boot software and provide technical recommendations. Own the end‑to‑end Boot software design and integration strategy for new controller architectures, from first samples through production launch. Execute advanced integration work to bring new controllers to operational status, including initial board bring‑up, flash programming, and startup sequence validation. Closely collaborate with solution and systems teams to define and evolve requirements for Boot to support current and future features. Develop and maintain controller flash partitioning, memory maps, and update concepts (OTA, recovery strategies) in collaboration with Security, Diagnostics, and Application teams. Lead root‑cause analysis and resolution of complex controller‑level issues related to Boot, startup timing, initialization order, and cross‑controller dependencies. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Software Integration Leaders (SWILs), other NATS, and program teams on Boot SW best practices and constraints. Define and refine strategies for flash programming, manufacturing programming flows, and service reprogramming to ensure robust, efficient updates across plants and field service environments. Collaborate closely with System and Software Architects, Safety, Cybersecurity, and Diagnostics stakeholders to ensure architectural consistency and compliance with safety and security requirements. Support development of standard work, guidelines, and reusable assets for Boot/BSW integration across controller families and programs. Influence portfolio and roadmap decisions by articulating technical risks, trade‑offs, and investment needs for new controller architectures. Your Skills & Abilities (Require Qualifications): Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field. Significant experience (typically 10+ years) in embedded software development for automotive or similarly safety‑critical, real‑time systems. Proven expertise with: MCU/SoC startup and Bootloader design (primary/secondary boot, secure boot, fallback/recovery concepts); Low‑level software integration (RTOS, memory, clock, reset, power management, communication interfaces such as CAN/LIN/FlexRay/Ethernet); Flash programming techniques, memory mapping, and resource optimization on constrained embedded platforms. Demonstrated ability to perform deep‑dive debugging using tools such as JTAG/trace, debuggers, logic analyzers, and low‑level logging. Strong systems thinking and ability to balance requirements from safety, cybersecurity, diagnostics, performance, and cost perspectives. High degree of comfort leveraging modern AI tools (e.g., code assistants, static/dynamic analysis, observability platforms) as part of day-to-day engineering workflows. People Skills: Excellent communication and documentation skills; able to clearly explain complex technical topics to diverse audiences. Proven track record providing technical leadership, influencing cross‑functional teams, and mentoring other engineers. Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior individual contributor (GM Level 8 or equivalent), setting technical direction and influencing roadmaps without direct people-management responsibility. What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications) Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline. Experience as a Technical Specialist, System Architect, or equivalent senior technical leadership role in embedded controls. Direct experience with: Automotive ECUs, AUTOSAR (Classic or Adaptive), and/or similar component‑based BSW architectures; Secure Boot, key management, and cryptographic concepts in embedded systems; OTA / FOTA update architectures, including rollback and recovery strategies. Prior work within GM controller, VMEC, or Mechatronic Software Platform organizations and familiarity with roles such as NATS, SWIL, and other Technical Specialists. Experience launching new controller families (new silicon, new E/E architectures) from concept through production. Demonstrated ability to define and institutionalize standard work, best practices, and reusable integration patterns across multiple programs and teams. DFSS, ASPICE, or Functional Safety (ISO 26262) experience related to low‑level and Boot software. 회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
직무 소개
CS Handyman은 고객이 상품 사용 중 겪는 다양한 문제를 신속하고 정확하게 해결할 수 있도록 지원하는 전문 Troubleshooting 서비스입니다. 고객 문의 데이터와 현장 운영 경험을 기반으로 문제 해결 프로세스를 지속적으로 개선하고, 상담 품질 및 고객 경험 향상을 통해 최고의 서비스 경험을 제공합니다.
가전/랩탑/설치/고객센터 운영팀 CS Specialist 는 Troubleshooting 서비스의 운영 전략을 수립하고 상담 KPI를 관리하며, 고객 경험 개선 과제를 기획하고 실행하는 역할을 담당합니다. 고객 관점에서 문제를 정의하고 운영 프로세스를 개선하여 서비스 효율성과 고객 만족도를 높이는 데 기여합니다.

고객 문의 및 VOC 분석을 통한 서비스 개선 과제 발굴

Job Description:

Join Intel and build a better tomorrow as an Intel Contract Employee. Our vision is to extend computing technology to connect and enrich the lives of every person on Earth. Come join us as a NM HoP Sort Module Equipment Technician and together let's grow and develop the next leading technology.

At Intel NM WPM there are exciting opportunities for growth at our Rio Rancho manufacturing facility. Build the future of technology with us - As Intel's Innovation Hub, the New Mexico site plays an important part in our efforts to make technology with the power to improve the life of everyone on the planet.
We're investing 3.5 billion dollars to expand and modernize our Rio Rancho facilities and creating thousands of new jobs along the way - all while building on our commitment to corporate responsibility with our RISE (Responsive, Inclusive, Sustainable, Enabling) strategy.

Job Responsibilities
The NM HOP Sort Module Equipment Technician is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and improving manufacturing equipment performance. Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• Perform electrical and mechanical troubleshooting to diagnose issues with non functioning manufacturing equipment.
• Dismantle, adjust, repair, install, and assemble equipment using layout plans, blueprints, operating manuals, and technical documentation.
• Execute equipment setup, calibration, and preventative maintenance; coordinate with equipment suppliers for service and repairs as needed.
• Monitor, analyze, and interpret equipment and performance data to improve tool reliability, availability, and overall module performance.
• Document system failures, update existing equipment specifications, and create new specifications supporting equipment maintenance and performance.
• Partner with Module Engineering to execute experiments, equipment configuration changes, and data collection activities in accordance with published procedures.
• Support engineering troubleshooting efforts through data analysis and controlled experimentation to meet or improve availability and performance targets and prevent future excursions.
• During factory ramps, collaborate with Module Engineering and construction teams to ensure tools are installed, converted, and qualified per design requirements.
• Maintain strict adherence to safety, quality, and procedural standards.
Note: This role requires regular onsite presence to fulfill essential job responsibilities.

Work Schedule and Physical Requirements
Candidates must be willing and able to:
• Work a compressed work week consisting of three consecutive 12 hour shifts, followed by a four day work week every other week.
Shift 4: (nights frontend) PM-AM Sun-Tues and alternating Saturday nights.
Shift 6: (nights backend) PM-AM Wed-Sat and alternating Saturday night.

• Perform work in a cleanroom environment while wearing required PPE, including coveralls, hood, booties, safety glasses, gloves, and respirator (when required).
• Lift up to 25 lbs up to five times per day.
• Spend the majority of the shift (over 90 percent, excluding breaks) in a cleanroom environment.
• Walk approximately 2-4 miles per shift and stand or sit for extended periods (up to 9 hours).
• Climb ladders as required by the role.
• Work in proximity to chemicals while following all safety procedures.

Required Behavioral Skills
• Strong safety mindset and commitment to following all safety protocols.
• Demonstrated ability to follow documented procedures and work with minimal supervision in a fast paced manufacturing environment.
• Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work effectively under dynamic conditions.
• Experience working in a team based environment.
• Self starter with a continuous learning mindset.
• Ability to multitask across multiple tools and responsibilities concurrently.
• High attention to detail, sound judgment, and initiative in resolving non standard equipment and process issues.
• Ability to develop clear, data driven recommendations.
• Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with peers, engineers, and internal customers.
• Basic computer literacy, including use of email, web based systems, and common productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Office).

Qualifications:

jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

The Role

As a Product Manager focused on Meta Systems for VALORANT Mobile, you will help shape the out-of-match experience that supports players before, between, and after every tactical fight.

You will work on player-facing systems including, but not limited to, progression, social features, asset display, party-up experience, player identity, and other systems that deepen long-term engagement. Your goal is to ensure VALORANT Mobile does not only feel great in the round, but also gives players meaningful reasons to return, connect, express themselves, and grow over time.

This role requires strong player empathy, structured product thinking, and the ability to translate ambiguous player needs into clear product direction. You will partner closely with Quantum Studio, our co-development partner, as well as Riot VALORANT teams, designers, engineers, publishing stakeholders, and other Riot partners to define feature goals, review implementation quality, and continuously improve the player experience through data, research, and product intuition.

As a Rioter in China, you’ll join a team of culturally diverse professionals who share a passion for games and a commitment to putting players first. To support Riot’s collaborative culture in our China offices, we operate without traditional hierarchical titles. What matters here is ownership, autonomy, and impact, not what’s printed on your badge.

Responsibilities:

• Drive the product direction and execution support for VALORANT Mobile meta systems, including progression, social, party-up, asset display, player identity, and other out-of-match player experiences.
• Partner closely with Quantum Studio to define product goals, feature requirements, user flows, experience principles, and acceptance criteria for new and existing meta system features.
• Review and refine Quantum Studio’s feature implementation throughout the development cycle, ensuring the final player experience is intuitive, polished, and aligned with VALORANT’s product quality bar.
• Use player behavior data, research insights, competitive references, and product intuition to identify opportunities that improve engagement, retention, social connection, and long-term player motivation.
• Collaborate with Riot VALORANT teams, publishing stakeholders, and other product owners to ensure meta system direction aligns with broader VALORANT product principles, version planning, live operations, and player needs.
• Support the planning and prioritization of meta system improvements across patches, balancing player impact, development cost, business goals, and delivery timelines.
• Act as the voice of VALORANT Mobile players in the meta system space, ensuring features serve both core tactical shooter players and broader mobile audiences.
• Monitor post-launch feature performance and player feedback, then build actionable optimization plans with Quantum Studio and relevant Riot stakeholders for future iterations.
• Contribute to cross-functional discussions on how meta systems connect with gameplay, monetization, content, social, and live service strategies.

Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience in product management, game operations, system design, or live service games, preferably with experience in mobile games.
• Experience owning or supporting player-facing systems such as progression, social, party, profile, collection, achievement, mission, onboarding, or other engagement-related systems.
• Strong product judgment and player empathy, with the ability to identify player needs and translate them into clear product requirements and experience improvements.
• Ability to work through moderately complex product problems, evaluate trade-offs, and propose practical solutions within defined constraints.
• Strong data literacy, with experience using engagement, retention, funnel, social, or feature usage data to evaluate product performance and guide iteration.
• Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with experience working closely with design, engineering, publishing, analytics, research, or external development partners.
• Experience working in a co-development or distributed team environment, including aligning stakeholders across different teams, cultures, or regions.
• Fluent in Mandarin and English.

Desired Qualifications:

• Deep passion for competitive multiplayer games, tactical shooters, or mobile live service games.
• Experience working on meta systems for a major live service title, especially systems related to progression, social connection, player identity, or long-term engagement.
• Strong understanding of mobile player behavior and how meta systems support retention, session motivation, social play, and content discovery.
• Familiarity with VALORANT, its player motivations, competitive ecosystem, cosmetics culture, and overall product identity.
• Experience using player research, community feedback, and market references to shape product direction.
• Experience working with co-development partners, external studios, or large-scale distributed development teams on feature delivery and quality review.

职位介绍

作为 VALORANT Mobile 团队负责 Meta Systems 的产品经理 ，你将参与塑造玩家在每一场战斗前、战斗间隙以及战斗结束后的整体游戏体验。

你将负责的玩家体验系统包括但不限于局内外成长、社交功能、资产展示、组队体验、玩家身份表达，以及其他能够提升长期参与度的局外系统。你的目标是确保 VALORANT Mobile 不只是在对局内有出色的战术竞技体验，也能在对局外持续给玩家提供回归、连接、表达自我与长期成长的理由。

这个职位需要你具备强烈的玩家同理心、结构化的产品思考能力，以及将模糊玩家需求转化为清晰产品方向的能力。你将与我们的联合研发伙伴 Quantum Studio，以及 Riot VALORANT 团队、设计、工程、发行团队和其他 Riot 内部伙伴密切合作，定义功能目标，审核落地质量，并通过数据、研究与产品判断持续优化玩家体验。

在 Riot 中国办公室，你将加入一支由不同文化背景的专业伙伴组成的团队。我们共同热爱游戏，也始终坚持以玩家为中心。为了支持 Riot 在中国办公室的协作文化，我们不强调传统层级头衔。真正重要的是你所承担的责任、展现的自主性，以及最终创造的影响力。

职责描述

• 推动 VALORANT Mobile Meta Systems 的产品方向与落地支持，包括局内外成长、社交、组队、资产展示、玩家身份表达，以及其他局外玩家体验系统。
• 与联合研发伙伴紧密合作，定义新功能与现有功能的产品目标、功能需求、用户流程、体验原则和验收标准。
• 在开发周期中持续审核并优化联合研发伙伴的功能实现，确保最终玩家体验直观、精致，并符合 VALORANT 的产品质量标准。
• 结合玩家行为数据、用户研究、竞品参考与产品判断，识别能够提升参与度、留存、社交连接和长期玩家动机的优化机会。
• 与 Riot VALORANT 团队、发行团队以及其他产品负责人合作，确保 Meta Systems 的方向与更广泛的 VALORANT 产品原则、版本规划、运营节奏和玩家需求保持一致。
• 支持不同版本中 Meta Systems 优化内容的规划和优先级排序，在玩家影响、研发成本、业务目标和交付时间之间做出合理取舍。
• 代表 VALORANT Mobile 玩家在 Meta Systems 领域提出清晰观点，确保相关功能既能服务核心战术射击玩家，也能兼顾更广泛的移动端玩家群体。
• 追踪功能上线后的表现与玩家反馈，并与联合研发伙伴和相关 Riot 团队一起制定可执行的后续优化计划。

基本要求

• 拥有 5 年以上产品管理、游戏运营、系统设计或长线运营游戏相关经验，有移动游戏经验者优先。
• 曾负责或参与过玩家体验系统，例如成长、社交、组队、个人资料、收藏、成就、任务、新手引导或其他与玩家参与度相关的系统。
• 具备良好的产品判断力和玩家同理心，能够识别玩家需求，并将其转化为清晰的产品需求和体验优化方案。
• 能够处理具有一定复杂度的产品问题，评估不同方案的取舍，并在明确约束下提出务实可行的解决方案。

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Intelligence and Investigations team is dedicated to ensuring the safe, responsible deployment of AI by rapidly detecting and mitigating abuse. Our team leverages the latest testing methodologies to uncover vulnerabilities and emerging threats, helping safeguard OpenAI’s products and users. We work closely with cross-functional partners across product, policy, and engineering to drive a comprehensive defense strategy against evolving adversarial challenges.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Red Team Specialist focused on cyber, you will help answer two practical questions: What cyber capabilities can our models provide to real-world attackers, and do our safeguards remain effective when those attackers use increasingly sophisticated techniques?

The role combines scaled evaluation with expert-driven testing. You may bring deeper experience in cybersecurity and use that expertise to judge whether a model’s behavior meaningfully changes attacker capability. Alternatively, you may bring deeper experience in model evaluations, automation, or agentic harnesses and apply those skills to building rigorous cyber testing. We do not expect every candidate to be equally deep in both areas, but successful candidates will have a strong foundation in one and enough fluency in the other to work effectively across the boundary.

Most of your work will focus on model cyber capabilities and safeguards; you will also spend a portion of your time testing novel abuse risks in agentic systems.

This role is located in San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Design and run rigorous evaluations of model cyber capabilities and safeguards, including policy adherence, correct refusal, over refusal, and resilience to jailbreaking and other adversarial techniques.

- Conduct hands-on testing to understand what models can enable when used by experienced security practitioners, including through task-specific harnesses, scaffolding, and multi-step workflows.

- Distinguish benchmark or policy failures from behavior that creates meaningful real-world risk, considering feasibility, attacker uplift, reliability, and the capabilities already available elsewhere.

- Build and improve automated testing infrastructure that supports repeatable measurement, rapid iteration, and statistically grounded analysis across models and product surfaces.

- Test novel abuse risks in agentic systems, including indirect prompt injection, agent hijacking, and other ways adversaries may manipulate systems that use tools or act on external information.

- Translate findings into clear risk assessments and actionable recommendations for Security, Research, Product, Policy, and Engineering partners.

- Contribute a portion of your time to Safety Bug Bounty work, particularly where reports require cyber expertise.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

Bring substantial depth in at least one of the following areas:

- Cybersecurity, such as application security, penetration testing, vulnerability research, adversary simulation, or red-team operations. You can assess whether a demonstrated capability is reliable, feasible, and meaningfully dangerous.

- AI model evaluation, such as designing and running evals, building agentic harnesses, automating adversarial testing, constructing datasets, or analyzing model behavior at scale. You can turn an ambiguous risk question into a reproducible testing approach.

Across either profile, you should also have:

- Working literacy across both cybersecurity and model evaluation, with an interest in developing further depth outside your primary area.

- The ability to write code and build practical testing tools, particularly for automating experiments, orchestrating models, or analyzing results.

- An attacker mindset and an interest in discovering failure modes that standard evaluations may not capture.

- Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical findings, limitations, and risk to audiences with different backgrounds.

- Experience working across technical and non-technical teams to move from a finding to a decision, mitigation, or follow-up test.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are seeking a software-fluent ECAD Interdisciplinary Systems Engineer to join the Engineering Practice & Configuration Management team. This role mirrors the mechanical domain's custom tooling function-you will build the integration tooling and automation that connects EE design systems (Xpedition, EDM, Teamcenter) into a seamless, reliable configuration management backbone.

You will build the connective tissue between EE's core design systems—Xpedition, EDM, and Teamcenter—creating intelligent automation for IDX exchanges, component synchronization, and BOM reconciliation that eliminates manual handoffs and scales with the program. This will result into a world-class tooling velocity and cross-system reliability for the EE domain.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Custom Integration Tooling: Design, build, and maintain automation that synchronizes data across Xpedition, EDM, and Teamcenter-keeping the 6000+ part component library dimensionally consistent and properly linked across all systems
• BOM Reconciliation Automation: Build tooling that guarantees Teamcenter BOM, Xpedition BOM, and supply-chain BOMs match at design release; enable where-used analysis; flag missing or dropped components; block PCBA release when parts are out of sync or unreleased
• IDX Exchange Improvement: Automate and harden the ECAD-MCAD collaboration workflow (IDX process); implement the validated scheme file as default configuration; build guardrails that prevent protocol deviations that destroy design history
• Build-to-Design Loop Closure: Pull as-built BOM data from supply-chain systems and contract manufacturer red-lines back into engineering tools, enabling true end-to-end data accuracy
• Component Dimensional Integrity Tooling: Build automated verification that detects and prevents dimensional mismatches of component definition between EDM and Teamcenter to enable identification PCBA-to-enclosure fitment failures in CAD and before fabrication
• Release Workflow Automation: Develop release gates and automated checks that enforce component maturity requirements, BOM consistency, and data completeness before PCBA release approval
• Tooling Backlog Ownership: Maintain and prioritize the EE tooling backlog (mirroring mechanical's 47+ item backlog); partner with the EE Configuration Manager to identify highest-impact automation opportunities
• Cross-Domain Integration: Ensure EE tooling integrates cleanly with existing in-house designed mechanical tooling infrastructure for unified cross-domain workflows
• Developer Documentation: Maintain technical documentation for all custom tooling, APIs, and integrations to ensure sustainability and team knowledge transfer

A day in the life
You will be responsible to work across multiple engineering functions to understand the daily pain points of a responsible engineering and translating those into the custom ECAD tools for EE domain.

About the team
The Configuration Management team develops and governs the engineering systems, standards, and processes that ensure spacecraft design data remains accurate, traceable, and controlled throughout the product lifecycle. While the organization originated as a traditional design support function, it has evolved into the engineering authority for product data management and engineering configuration.

The team defines how engineering information flows throughout the digital engineering environment, including Product Lifecycle Management workflows, mechanical and electrical design tool integration, engineering data management, and the interaction between Teamcenter, Siemens NX, Mentor, and other engineering platforms. They also develop tooling and automation that improves engineering productivity while maintaining data integrity across these systems.

In addition to managing engineering data, the organization serves as the company's subject matter experts in Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing. They develop engineering standards, mentor design engineers, and promote best practices that improve drawing quality, manufacturability, and technical consistency across the organization.

The team also defines and continuously improves the organization's configuration and change management processes for hardware, requirements, and engineering documentation. They work closely with software organizations to strengthen integrated hardware and software configuration control while ensuring traceability throughout the development lifecycle. Today the organization facilitates Engineering Change Committee and Configuration Control Board activities while actively developing increasingly automated workflows in partnership with the Engineering Information Systems team. These efforts continue moving the organization toward a more efficient, data driven approach to engineering governance.

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success.

We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience.

As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.

Responsibilities

Join our team as a Property Field Inspection Claim Specialist and showcase your expertise in handling accident and weather-related claims for homeowners, commercial properties, and large losses.

We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled professional to contribute to our dynamic team. State Farm is on the cutting edge with the use of technology to support claim employees in developing enhanced skillsets to support and protect our policyholders. Not Human or Digital. Human + Digital, working together. • Conduct on-site inspections and assessments of property damages for both residential and commercial claims
• Collaborate with policyholders, insurance agents, and other involved parties to gather information and resolve claims efficiently
• May occasionally require interacting with parties who express strong emotions or concerns about ongoing inspections or claim resolutions
• Provide exceptional customer service throughout the claims process, addressing inquiries and concerns promptly and professionally
• Gather necessary evidence, document findings, and prepare detailed reports to support the claims handling process
• Investigate and adjust both personal and commercial property claims with exposures up to $500,000
• Evaluate coverage and policy terms to determine the validity of claims and ensure compliance with local regulations
• Negotiate and settle claims within the authorized limits, considering policy provisions, industry standards, and company guidelines

Where you'll work: This position is located in Dallas NW. and Fort Worth, TX. Competitive candidates should reside within one of the listed zip codes and will service this same territory:

Dallas NW: 75201 75202 75205 75207 75208 75209 75212 75219 75220 75225 75235 75247

Fort Worth, TX: 76016 76017 76020 76036 76053 76060 76102 76103 76104 76105 76106 76107 76108 76109 76110 76111 76112 76114 76115 76116 76117 76118 76119 76120 76123 76126 76132 76133 76134 76135 76137 76140 76164 76179 76180

This is a Remote-Field position in which you will work from home and utilize a mobile office/vehicle for in-person appointments. Although the primary work location is in the field, with a commutable distance from home, there will be opportunities for virtual work to be completed at home. Additionally, there may be occasions where you will be required to travel outside your assigned area to assist in other territories.

Hours of operation are continually evaluated and may change based on business need. Successful candidates are able and willing to work flexible schedules and may be asked to work overtime and/or irregular hours.

Qualifications

Competitive candidates must demonstrate:

• Ability to investigate problems, evaluate information, and make well-supported decisions
• Ability to interpret detailed policies, guidelines, or technical information and apply them accurately to real-world situations
• Ability to quickly learn unfamiliar concepts, processes, and terminology and apply that knowledge accurately in practical situations
• Ability to effectively interact with policyholders, agents, and other stakeholders to move claims forward efficiently
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills to handle difficult/emotional conversations with a customer-minded focus
• Detail-oriented with strong organizational and analytical skills
• Proficiency in using mobile/desktop tools to document and support claims both in the field and remotely
• Physical agility to allow for: walking; bending, reaching, kneeling, squatting, stooping, frequent lifting, carrying, unfolding, and climbing a ladder; ability to utilizing appropriate equipment in accordance with safety guidelines to traverse roofs at various heights and pitches for inspection of both residential and commercial structures; ability to crawl in tight spaces to gather information needed during the adjustment of a claim.

• Customer service experience (e.g., assisting customers, handling inquiries/concerns professionally, communicating clearly and empathetically), demonstrating transferable skills that support client interactions in a Claims environment
• Understanding of property insurance concepts, including coverage fundamentals and general claim handling practices
• Baseline knowledge of residential and commercial building construction and building components/materials
Familiarity with water mitigation principles and inspection processes
• Working knowledge of Xactimate and XactContents

• Employees must successfully complete all required training, including applicable proficiency, licensing exam(s), Motor Vehicle Recrd (MVR) checks, and background checks required of various state(s).
• State Farm recently implemented new pre-employment assessments. Candidates that have previously taken an assessment may be asked to participate in additional testing.

Because work-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45-hour work week!

• Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience

• Stay Well! Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more!

You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union!

With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you!
• Give Back! We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund.
